name: Εθνικό μονοπάτι O3
description_md:
The national waymarked hiking route O3 covers a distance of 172.0 km in GR. This hard route requires about 72 hours of walking time according to the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The path is signposted as O3 and is part of the national waymarked hiking network. It features 9682 m of ascent and 9268 m of descent. The route passes Vikos Gorge within 100 m and Viewpoint Oxia within 400 m.
